items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...in the whole recording there’s the head and then I think the sax player plays. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Uh huh. Bob Sheppard.

ctx.x: Yeah. So I wanted to ask you about what happened there. Because of course in the whole recording there’s the head and then I think the sax player plays.
Bob Sheppard. Then there’s this piano solo. And it gets pretty intense. And then you come in and there’s a lot of space. And I’m wondering, I was thinking how deliberate and how preplanned was that?
